Class CsvUtils

public inherited sharing class CsvUtils

Utility classes for reading, writing, and manipulating CSV (comma-separated values) data. Provides CsvReader for parsing CSV content, CsvWriter for generating CSV output, and supporting classes CsvLine, CsvHeaders, and CsvGenericLine for managing individual rows and columns with type-safe accessors.
